new_result.statement: If an original-coordinate 4x4 principal block B has exact rank three, B_00=0, nonzero eigenvalues |mu_j|>=s, and hub range leverage h=||P_range(B)e_0||^2>0, then arbitrary independent cap-one inputs and arbitrary affine terms obey ||p||_inf <= 576^(1/3) s^(-1) h^(-1/3). The same bound lifts to an arbitrary ambient form by conditioning outside the block.

primary_sources.citation: Livshyts-Paouris-Pivovarov, On sharp bounds for marginal densities of product measures, arXiv:1507.07949 / Israel J. Math. 216 (2016)
primary_sources.scope_match: cap-one product densities; k-dimensional orthogonal marginal density <=2^(k/2); no moment/iid/support/log-concavity/smoothness assumptions

primary_sources.citation: Herry-Malicet-Poly, Regularity of laws via Dirichlet forms -- Application to quadratic forms in independent and identically distributed random variables, arXiv:2303.09488
primary_sources.scope_match: does not match full target: iid sufficiently smooth Gaussian-functional input class and additional regularity assumptions

remaining_implication: The cofactor bound deteriorates as hub range leverage h->0. Need a structural selection/routing lemma producing quantitative h or routing low-h into a paid cross-volume/ridge/grouped-source branch; arbitrary extra spectrum is not removed by this theorem.
